current_legacy_carrier.disposition: PRESERVE_UNTIL_CARTRIDGE_GEOMETRY_PASSES; do not silently delete M030

owner_architecture.service_rule: Remove four cabinet fasteners, disconnect one service connector, withdraw complete cartridge, then slide/remove end caps to separate the three acrylic layers.
owner_architecture.loose_hardware_target: NONE during routine cartridge disassembly where practical
owner_architecture.electrical_connection_target: ONE keyed detachable connector with service loop and strain relief

design_requirements.diffuser_air_gap_rule: Set by optical prototype; do not place diffuser directly against LEDs by default.
design_requirements.thermal_expansion_rule: End-cap channels must retain layers without hard-clamping acrylic across full width.
design_requirements.cabinet_interface_rule: Permanent wood should see only the cartridge mounting interface, not LED-specific hole geometry.
design_requirements.future_replacement: Change acrylic index layer/end caps/LED carrier without recutting cabinet wood where practical.

pending_validation: Select real LED matrix/strip/module and measure LED package, pitch, PCB/strip thickness, connector and wire exit.
Prototype diffuser spacing for hotspot suppression versus brightness.
Check 4-screw end-cap mounting pattern against current backbox/matrix keepouts and folded-service path.
Check connector clearance and service loop with matrix removal.
Decide whether M030 is retired, reused as a backing datum, or replaced by the cartridge after CAD comparison.
Validate acrylic edge clearances and retention during backbox fold.
